# nagios_contactgroup (Data Source)

Reads an existing Nagios XI contactgroup.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nagios_contactgroup" "example" {
  contactgroup_name = "admins"
}

output "admins_members" {
  value = data.nagios_contactgroup.example.members
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `contactgroup_name` (String) The name of the contact group

### Read-Only

- `alias` (String) A longer description of the contact group
- `contactgroup_members` (Set of String) A list of other contactgroups whose members should be included in this group
- `members` (Set of String) A list of the short names of contacts that are members of this group
